questions.question: A query constrains ambience (quiet) while others constrain text meaning. How should retrieval score that?
options: Text scores only, ambience ignored
Audio scores only, meaning ignored
One blended score with no breakdown
Per-modality scores fused with documented weights
questions.explanation: Modalities constrain differently. This lesson scores each and fuses transparently.

questions.question: What happens for image_retrieve('sunny airy') in the restaurant corpus?
options: Steak Central wins because dark is the only image tag
Every restaurant receives zero because image_retrieve accepts only exact tag names
Sunday Plant Bistro alone gets 1.0 because it has natural_light
Morning Glow receives 1.0 because it has both natural_light and airy tags
questions.explanation: 'sunny' adds natural_light and 'airy' adds airy to tag_hints. Morning Glow has both, so its score is 2/2 = 1.0; Sunday Plant Bistro has only one.

questions.question: How does fuse combine the three modality score dictionaries in agentic_loop?
options: It computes a weighted sum using the supplied weights for each restaurant ID
It keeps only the highest modality score and discards the other two
It averages raw review text strings instead of numeric scores
It concatenates the dictionaries and lets duplicate IDs overwrite earlier scores
questions.explanation: fuse loops over CORPUS and adds w*score for each pair from scores_list and weights. agentic_loop uses [0.3, 0.4, 0.3] in its first round.

questions.question: Which citations does grounded_generate append for each ranked restaurant?
options: Only a model confidence number with no source ID
[review id], [img tags ...], and [ambient ...dB] alongside the restaurant name
A page number and OCR bounding box from LayoutLMv3
A URL generated from the restaurant's name
questions.explanation: The generated line includes the review ID, image tags, and ambient decibel value. These modality-specific source markers make the answer auditable.

questions.question: What does agentic_loop do when the first fused confidence is below confidence_floor?
options: It returns an empty answer because retrieval failed
It removes the audio scores and keeps the original ranking
It appends 'bright windows low noise', reruns image/audio retrieval with new weights, and ranks again
It changes the restaurant corpus so the top score reaches the floor
questions.explanation: The low-confidence branch reformulates the query, recomputes image and audio scores, fuses them with [0.3,0.5,0.2], and records a second-round trace.

questions.question: Which trio appears in surveys_table as the 2025 multimodal-RAG survey authors?
options: Radford, Faysse, and Li
DeepMind, OpenAI, and NVIDIA
ColBERT, PaliGemma, and Qwen
Abootorabi et al., Mei et al., and Zhao et al.
questions.explanation: surveys_table lists Abootorabi et al. (February), Mei et al. (April), and Zhao et al. (March) with their respective taxonomy and benchmark emphases.
